When importers already move freight through a major port, proximity matters. A bonded warehouse in Savannah allows companies to unload containers, store goods in-bond, and make informed decisions about U.S. entry or re-export—without immediately paying duties.
The Section 301 action on Chinese imports, finalized in the US Trade Representative's September 2024 four-year review, kept Lists 1 through 4A at 7.5 to 25 percent
Section 301 merchandise must be admitted to a zone in privileged foreign status, which locks its rate at admission, and the duty is collected when the goods enter US commerce.
Most import-eligible products can be stored in a bonded warehouse, such as apparel, food products, alcohol, electronics, automotive parts, raw materials, and luxury goods.
